# dsh-review
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a code review workflow to `/review` and `/end-review`.
`/review --deep` runs the review as a fleet: one fresh reviewer per lens and file shard scans the ch
ange in parallel, then independent adversarial verifier lanes, each blind to the orchestrator and to
every other lane, try to break every finding before it reaches the report. With `--aggressive`, unp
roven findings are reported as suspicions instead of being withheld.
It reviews uncommitted changes, changes against a base branch, a single commit, a GitHub pull reques
t (checked out locally through `gh`), or a set of paths as a snapshot. Findings get a priority from
`[P0]` to `[P3]` and a confidence level. Two kinds of non-blocking notes are kept separate from the
fix items: Side Effects & Breaking Changes, and Simplification Opportunities, behavior-preserving cl
eanups reported with a concrete suggested change.

## Commands
Diff modes require a git repository.
| Command | Description |
| `/review` or `/review uncommitted` | Reviews the working tree: staged, unstaged, and untracked fil

es. |
| `/review branch [<name>]` | Reviews the changes against a base branch: the named one, or the

repository's default. |
| `/review commit <sha> [<title>]` | Reviews one commit; text after the SHA

becomes the review title. |
| `/review pr <number\|url>` | Checks the PR out locally through `gh` a
nd reviews it against its base branch. Needs `gh` installed and signed in, and blocks on uncommitted

changes to tracked files. |
| `/review path <paths...>` | Reviews the paths as a snapshot, not a di
ff. Skips hidden files (except `.agents`) and `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `coverage`, `vendor`.

|
| `/review <focus text>` | Any other text becomes the review focus; the reviewer decides what to

inspect. |
| `/review instructions <text>` | Stores custom instructions appended to every review thi

s session. The bare word `clear` removes them; quote it to store the literal word. |
| `/review stat
us` | Shows whether a review is active, its target, and the stored instructions. |
Composer file attachments become snapshot targets: they merge with `/review path`, and are refused i
n diff modes, with free-form focus text, and as images.
| Flag | Description |
| `--extra "<instruction>"` | Adds one instruction to any mode, on top of stored session instruction

s. |
| `--aggressive` | Reports candidates instead of withholding them: every finding keeps a confid

ence label and stays grounded in the real diff. Composes with any mode. |
| `--deep` | Runs the flee

t review, described below. |
| `--timeout <seconds>` | With `--deep`, sets both fleet worker time li

mits for this run. |
| `--concurrency <workers>` | With `--deep`, sets the fleet pool size for this
run; capped to the harness's active-subagent capacity. |
### `/end-review [summarize|fix|done]`
- `summarize` (the default) queues a structured handoff: scope, verdict, findings, and an ordered fi

x queue.
- `fix` queues a follow-up turn that implements the findings in priority order.
- `done` cl

ears the session back to ordinary coding work.
- `status` shows the review state without finishing i

rs the session back to ordinary coding work.
- `status` shows the review state without finishing it.
Findings show up as an ordinary turn, so you can talk to the reviewer while it works.
## Deep review (`--deep`)
Deep review costs many times a regular review and takes much longer. `/review --deep [mode]` runs th
ree stages through the existing agent loop:
1. **Scan.** One fresh reviewer per lens (correctness, failure paths, security, contracts, consisten
cy, propagation, simplification; `performance` opt-in) reviews the change in parallel; large diffs s

hard the file-local lenses.
2. **Consolidate.** The orchestrator groups duplicate findings by root c

ause and drops what does not qualify.
3. **Verify.** Independent adversarial verifier lanes (reprodu
cer, skeptic, consistency, provenance, impact, fix-auditor, simplifier) judge each finding from one
dimension. The lanes read only the stored claims, stripped of reviewer identity and shuffled per lan
e, so no lane can see another's reasoning.
Only findings the lanes confirm reach the report; contested, inconclusive and unverified ones are wi
thheld as one-liners, and the provenance lane dismisses findings that predate the change or are inte
ntional. The orchestrator copies the verified findings into the report and cannot rewrite them; it a
lso adds a per-finding lane verdict table, coverage, and the Side Effects & Breaking Changes and Sim
plification Opportunities sections. Simplifications never change the verdict and never enter the fix
queue: `/end-review fix` treats them as informational.
Your typed messages during a deep review reach every worker started after them, and the session's st
ored instructions, `--extra` text and project `REVIEW_GUIDELINES.md` ride to every fleet worker.

| `deep.revi
ewerAgentOptions` / `verifierAgentOptions` | none | Model and route for reviewers and verifier lanes

; a verifier model unlike the reviewers' makes verification more independent. |
| `deep.lenses` | al

l seven | Which reviewer lenses run. |
| `deep.reviewerTools` | `bash, read, grep, glob` | Tools the

workers may use. |
| `deep.maxReviewers` | `15` | Reviewer runs in one scan. |
| `deep.shardThresho

ldLines` | `1500` | Changed lines above which the file-local lenses shard. |
